reason: Superseded by the v1.3 instrumentation amendment. These are the records underlying every currently published B+ number (arXiv:2606.30566). bplus_scored_LEGACY.json.note: Scoring of the archived records. These are the E1/E3 values cited in arXiv:2606.30566 (E1 720/720 all cells; E3 459/720, 441/720, 1/720, 220/720). E3 re-verified 2026-09-19 against the serialized frozen RF: identical.

bplus_stage2_selection_D3_from_confirmat.note: The >=20% memory-relevance filter as originally computed. Deviation D3: computed from the confirmatory files, not an independent pilot. All 36 email scenarios passed at rate 1.0 because the unwired store (D1) made every session emit a memory call, so the filter was a no-op.
